shape: someone who lives far away now, and the one small habit you both kept

slides.text: we haven't shared a fridge in years, but [[we both still leave one sip]] in the carton so someone else has to bin it.

caption:
some kitchen habits were learned before school and never got unlearned.
even with two different fridges three states away.
send this to your sister who still leaves the last mouthful for someone else.

#siblings #sisterlove #siblinglove #growingupwithsiblings
